entries.text: Brightwater Labs registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Brightwater pH Meter: a benchtop meter with a replaceable probe. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Registered product terms. Intended use: laboratory water testing on a fixed bench. Billing model: a one-time purchase with no subscription and no automatic renewal.
